title: 第256章 又见断腿第260章 神威侯府的好日子才刚刚开始
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 眼看着王大山一个快步走到了面前。
王渊吓的腿都软了，下意识的就想往后躲。
可是王大山根本没给他机会。
王渊把衣领像拎小鸡一样提起来，硬生生的把他整个人给提起来。
“放……放开我。”
王渊惊慌失措，双脚悬在半空中，拼命扑腾挣扎。
“哥。你别动手。”
王渊咽了口唾沫，声音里带有明显的哭腔。
“咱们有话好好说，我是你亲弟弟啊。”
为了活命，这会儿连脸都不要了。
王大山听着这话。嘴角扯了一下直接被逗笑了。
王大山微微偏了偏头，用一种看白痴的眼神看着王渊。
“我这记性可能不太好。”
“我可不记得，我有你这么一号贪生怕死的废物弟弟。”
王大山的眼睛瞬间变冷，手上的力道又加重了几分。
勒的王渊直翻白眼，快要喘不过气来了。
“再说了。”
“刚才在外面，不是你哭着喊着。”
“闹死闹活的说要自杀吗？”
王大山冷笑了一声。
“我看你也就是个软骨头，根本没胆子自己动手。”
“既然这样，今天我就大发慈悲，来成全你。”
话音落下。
王大山空出的另一只手直接握成了拳头，摆明了就是要直接动手，废了这个不知死活的东西。
一直站在旁边发抖的李清玉终于回过了神。
眼看着自己的宝贝儿子要挨打。
她也顾不上害怕了。
李清玉冲上去就把王渊给挡住了，张开双臂死死的挡在王渊身前。
“混账东西。”
虽然心里直打鼓，但是还是强撑着摆出了一副当家主母的架子。
她伸出戴着玉镯的手，指着王大山的鼻子破口大骂。
“你快给我住手。”
“赶紧把你弟弟放开。”
李清玉咬着牙，眼神死死盯着王大山，放出了狠话。
“我告诉你，渊儿可是侯府的嫡子。”
“要是他今天被你伤到了一根毫毛，我都绝对饶不了你。”
随着李清玉的这番话。
空气似乎都跟着安静了一下。
王大山动作停住了。
他没有松开王渊，而慢慢的转过头。
看向了挡在前面的李清玉。
content_en:
Seeing Wang Dashan walking quickly in front of him.
Wang Yuan was so frightened that his legs went weak, and he subconsciously wanted to hide back.
But Wang Dashan didn't give him a chance at all.
Wang Yuan lifted up his collar like a chicken, forcefully lifting his whole body up.
"Let...let me go."
Wang Yuan panicked, his feet were hanging in the air, and he was struggling desperately.
"Brother. Don't do anything."
Wang Yuan swallowed, with an obvious cry in his voice.
"If we have something to talk about, I'm your biological brother."
In order to survive, I don’t even have to show my face at this moment.
Wang Dashan listened to this. The corner of his mouth twitched and he was immediately amused.
"Brother??"
Wang Dashan tilted his head slightly and looked at Wang Yuan with an idiot look.
"My memory may not be very good."
"I don't remember that I have a good-for-nothing brother like you who is greedy for life and afraid of death."
Wang Dashan's eyes instantly turned cold, and the strength in his hands became a little stronger.
Wang Yuan rolled his eyes and was almost out of breath.
"Say no more."
"It wasn't you who was crying and shouting outside just now."
"Are you saying that you want to commit suicide?"
Wang Dashan sneered.
"I think you are just a weakling, and you don't have the guts to do it yourself."
"In this case, I will show great mercy and come to help you today."
The words fell.
Wang Dashan's free hand was directly clenched into a fist, making it clear that he wanted to take action directly and destroy this ignorant thing.
Li Qingyu, who had been standing by and shaking, finally came to his senses.
Seeing his precious son about to be beaten.
She couldn't care less about being afraid.
Li Qingyu rushed forward and blocked Wang Yuan, spreading his arms to block Wang Yuan.
"Bastard thing."
Although my heart was pounding, I still managed to put on the air of being the matron of the house.
She stretched out her hand wearing a jade bracelet, pointed at Wang Dashan's nose and cursed.
"Stop it now."
"Let your brother go quickly."
Li Qingyu gritted his teeth, stared at Wang Dashan, and said harsh words.
"I tell you, Yuan'er is the legitimate son of the Hou family."
"If he gets hurt by you today, I will never forgive you."
Following Li Qingyu's words.
The air seemed to become quiet.
Wang Dashan stopped moving.
He did not let go of Wang Yuan, but slowly turned his head.
He looked at Li Qingyu who was blocking the front.
title_en: Chapter 256: Seeing the broken leg again Chapter 260: The good days of the Shenwei Hou Mansion have just begun
